name: blue-tomato-root
description: Root project to start all servers concurrently

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend -- --port 8081" "npm start --prefix vendor-app -- --port 8082" "npm run dev --prefix admin-web"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix vendor-app && npm install --prefix admin-web
